result.target_topic: Change in Useful Lives of Property, Plant, and Equipment
result.target_summary: In February 2023, the company increased the estimated useful lives of server, storage, network, and assembly/test equipment due to technological advances and usage rates. This change resulted in a fiscal 2024 benefit of $135 million to operating income and $114 million to net income.

target_year_over_year_context.explanation: Both disclosures describe the change in accounting estimate regarding the useful lives of server, storage, network, and assembly/test equipment due to technology advances. 2023 D046 (P047_S001-004) and 2024 D044 (P043_S001-003) both cover the assessment date (Feb 2023), the change in useful lives (3 to 4-5/7 years), and the estimated impact on operating income ($133M in 2023 report, $135M in 2024 report).

previous_disclosures.section: Critical Accounting Policies and Estimates > Change in Accounting Estimate
previous_disclosures.summary: In February 2023, NVIDIA assessed and increased the estimated useful life of a majority of server, storage, network, and assembly and test equipment, effective at the beginning of fiscal year 2024. This change is estimated to increase fiscal year 2024 operating income by $133 million due to reduced depreciation expense.

This quantification adds specific financial detail absent in the 2023 aggregate figure.

comparisons.peer_topic: Income Tax Provision and Effective Rate
comparisons.peer_summary: AMD recorded an income tax provision of $381 million in 2024 with a 19% effective tax rate, compared to a $346 million benefit and (68%) rate in 2023. The 2024 provision increase was driven by higher pre-tax income and a $373 million tax effect from an intercompany integration transaction.
comparisons.comparison: Both NVDA and AMD disclose specific changes in accounting estimates or significant adjustments that directly impacted their fiscal 2024 financial results, although the nature of the items differs (depreciation policy vs. tax provision). NVDA details a benefit to operating income and net income resulting from a change in the estimated useful lives of property, plant, and equipment, citing a $135 million increase in operating income and $114 million increase in net income. In contrast, AMD discloses an income tax provision of $381 million with a 19% effective rate, driven by higher pre-tax income and a specific $373 million tax effect from an intercompany integration transaction. While both items relate to accounting adjustments affecting the bottom line in FY2024, NVDA's is a forward-looking estimate change for depreciation, whereas AMD's is a tax provision result including a one-time integration effect.

sentences.text: The estimated effect of this change for fiscal year 2024 was a benefit of $33 million and $102 million for cost of revenue and operating expenses, respectively, which resulted in an increase in operating income of $135 million and net income of $114 million after tax, or $0.05 per both basic and diluted share.
The increase in income tax provision in 2024 was primarily due to higher pre-tax income and a $373 million tax effect from an intercompany integration transaction.
